item.sophisticatedcharging.charging_upgr:
Links every battery in the backpack (from any mod) into one energy pool
and charges your armor and held items from it.
Cables and chargers see the backpack as one big battery.
item.sophisticatedcharging.advanced_char:
Like the Charging Upgrade, but faster, and can also charge
your whole inventory, Curios slots and tools stored in the backpack.
Has a filter for what gets charged.
gui.sophisticatedcharging.status.chargin: Only one Charging Upgrade fits in a backpack
gui.sophisticatedcharging.buttons.do_not: Charge only armor and held items
gui.sophisticatedcharging.buttons.charge: Charge items stored in the backpack
gui.sophisticatedcharging.buttons.do_not: Don't charge items stored in the backpack
gui.sophisticatedcharging.pool.tooltip.h: Every battery in this backpack plus its Battery Upgrade.
